categories.name: Games

categories.desc: Programs for the Terminal: Lua, JavaScript, BASIC, SQLite, text adventures.

apps.author: Peter Hellberg
apps.description: The classic 2048 puzzle: slide the numbered tiles, merge matching pairs and keep doubling them until you build the 2048 tile.

apps.name: Break-It
apps.author: douglett
apps.description: A simple Breakout clone: bounce the ball, smash the bricks and loop through 5 levels for a high score - the game speeds up on every lap.

apps.name: Cosmic Inw4ders
apps.author: Pierro
apps.description: A take on Space Invaders: move your ship along the bottom of the screen and shoot down the invaders overhead.

apps.name: Freedoom: Phase 1
apps.author: The Freedoom project
apps.description: A complete free game for the Doom engine: four episodes of demons, bases and hell.

apps.name: JavaScript
apps.author: QuickJS-ng project (Bellard, Gordon, contributors)
apps.description: Modern JavaScript (ES2024) with QuickJS-ng: interactive prompt, scripts and modules, std/os file APIs, timers. Type js, or js file.js.

apps.name: Kitty Game
apps.author: Cannon Tuttle
apps.description: Find the kitties! Run, jump and use cards to track them all down. Arrows to move, X and Z to jump and use cards.

apps.name: Lua
apps.author: Lua.org, PUC-Rio
apps.description: Lua 5.4 in the Terminal: interactive prompt and scripts. Type lua for the prompt, lua script.lua to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: SQLite
apps.author: SQLite developers (D. Richard Hipp et al.)
apps.description: The SQLite shell: local SQL databases on the SD card, with JSON and math functions. Type sqlite3 notes.db.

apps.name: The Legend of GEML: Awakening
apps.author: Robby Zampino, Ethan Hunter
apps.description: A Zelda-inspired top-down adventure: explore a world of rocks, rivers and floor switches and find your way forward. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: ABC 123
apps.description: Learn letters and numbers with 7 mini-games. Multilingual, with voice.

apps.name: Cannon
apps.description: Artillery arcade: drag your finger to set angle and power, lift it to fire.

apps.name: Chess
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

apps.name: CHIP-8 Arcade
apps.author: NucleoOS; games by the CHIP-8 Community Archive authors
apps.description: 83 homebrew games from the CHIP-8 Community Archive (CC0) in a CHIP-8 / SUPER-CHIP / XO-CHIP console. On-screen keypad, gamepad and keyboard, colours and sound.

apps.name: Devices
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Shelly, WLED and Tasmota on your Wi-Fi, found automatically: see which are on and switch them with a tap. No Home Assistant, no cloud.

apps.name: Doom Engine
apps.author: NucleoOS (doomgeneric, Chocolate Doom, emu8950)
apps.description: The classic Doom engine (doomgeneric, from Chocolate Doom) tuned for this board: 4:3 picture, OPL music, keyboard, mouse and gamepads. Runs the Doom games from the Store and your own WADs.

apps.name: Home
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Home Assistant on the panel: lights, switches, covers, thermostats, locks, scenes and sensors by room. Tap to toggle, hold for brightness and details. Set the Home Assistant URL and token in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Pianino
apps.description: A colourful kids piano: rainbow keys and four instrument presets.

apps.name: Pomodoro Desk Hub
apps.description: Smart 7-inch desk dashboard: Pomodoro focus timer, monthly calendar, productivity stats, and dim night stand mode.

apps.name: Puzzles
apps.author: Simon Tatham et al.
apps.description: Simon Tatham's Portable Puzzle Collection: 40 logic puzzles (Bridges, Keen, Light Up, Loopy, Mines, Net, Pattern, Solo, Tents, Untangle...). Undo, solver, puzzle types; games are saved. MIT.

apps.name: Timer
apps.description: Stopwatch and countdown with an end beep. Big, tap-friendly digits.

apps.name: Tobu Tobu Girl
apps.author: Tangram Games (sound by potato-tan); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Tobu Tobu Girl by Tangram Games, a Game Boy arcade platformer: jump from cloud to cloud to catch the cat. Code MIT, art CC BY 4.0. Touch controls, gamepads, sound, saves.
apps.license: MIT (game code, emulator), CC BY 4.0 (game graphics, text and music)

apps.name: Vertice Bass
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Arcade fishing tournament in 3D: six lakes, eight species, three lures, nibbles and strikes, line-tension fights with jumps, and a record wall of your ten biggest fish.
apps.notes: Boat you drive with the d-pad, lake select with unlocks, livewell scoring, harder fights, and key hints when a keyboard or gamepad is plugged in.

apps.name: Vertice GP
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: 3D kart racing on the Vertice engine: four karts, three laps, drift turbo, boost pads, coins, rocket starts and slipstream. Touch, keyboard or gamepad.

apps.name: Weather
apps.description: Live global weather and forecasts powered by Open-Meteo with geolocation, settings, and animated graphics.

apps.name: Zigbee
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Zigbee2MQTT on the panel: devices appear by themselves, toggle lights and plugs, see temperature, humidity, doors, motion and battery. Needs the MQTT broker in Settings > Home.

apps.name: Zork I-III
apps.author: Infocom / Microsoft; MojoZork by Ryan C. Gordon
apps.description: Zork I, II and III, the classic 1980 text adventures, free under the MIT license. Type zork in the Terminal, or zork 2 for Zork II. SAVE and RESTORE keep one game per title.

apps.name: A Simple Space Invaders game
apps.author: LogicProjects
apps.description: A simple Space Invaders clone, coded live on YouTube: move your ship and shoot down the rows of alien invaders.

apps.name: Annoying Robots
apps.author: Shimon Ulewicz
apps.description: Race your robots across the board before your rival: big robots climb onto small ones and jumps chain like in checkers. Vs AI or 2 players. Arrows and Z to play.

apps.name: Antcopter
apps.author: Eduardo Bart
apps.description: Guide a tiny flying ant through maze-like cave levels lined with spikes, picking up items along the way. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: BASIC
apps.author: Adam Dunkels (uBASIC), Nucleo port
apps.description: Classic line-numbered BASIC: print/if/goto/gosub/for-next/input. Type basic prog.bas to run a program from /sdcard/home. Lowercase keywords, single-letter variables a-z.

apps.name: Meteoroids
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: An Asteroids-style shooter: move your ship, blast the meteoroids and steer clear of them. Use the arrows and buttons, or mouse and touch, to move and shoot.

apps.name: 1000 Lines 2
apps.author: Liberation and the 1000 Lines team
apps.description: 34-map community project, every map under 1000 lines, with its own textures.

apps.name: 2048 (Game Boy)
apps.author: Sanqui (game), tiles by beware; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: 2048 for the Game Boy by Sanqui (zlib), on the Peanut-GB emulator. Slide the tiles, reach 2048. High score saved.

apps.name: 5 Mazes
apps.author: godai (Gniazdo wiatów); music by AJ Booker; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Help Alice find her way through five mazes, each one larger and harder than the last. A small Game Boy maze game made with GB Studio by godai, music by AJ Booker. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator with sound, touch controls and...
apps.license: MIT (Homebrew Hub lists CC BY-SA 4.0) (game); MIT (emulator)

apps.name: 5 Mazes: Master Levels
apps.author: godai (Gniazdo wiatów); music by AJ Booker; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: The last chapter of the 5 Mazes series: the largest and hardest mazes for Alice. Game Boy game made with GB Studio by godai, music by AJ Booker. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator with sound, touch controls and gamepads. MIT license...
apps.license: MIT (Homebrew Hub lists CC BY-SA 4.0) (game); MIT (emulator)

apps.name: 5 More Mazes
apps.author: godai (Gniazdo wiatów); music by AJ Booker; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: The sequel to 5 Mazes: five new mazes for Alice, each larger and harder than the last. Game Boy game made with GB Studio by godai, music by AJ Booker. Runs on the built-in Game Boy emulator with sound, touch controls and gamepads. MIT...
apps.license: MIT (Homebrew Hub lists CC BY-SA 4.0) (game); MIT (emulator)

apps.name: A Change in the Weather
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Walking away from a picnic you are caught in a country storm and must save a bridge. Short and tricky. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1995). Type if-change-in-the-weather in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Adventure
apps.author: Will Crowther & Don Woods; Glulx port by Daniel Fox Franke; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: Colossal Cave Adventure 2.5 (430 points), the original cave-crawling treasure hunt that started the genre. Text adventure in English (Will Crowther & Don Woods; Glulx port by Daniel Fox Franke, 1977). Type if-adventure in the Terminal...

apps.name: AIRPLANZ
apps.author: NotImplementedLife; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: AIRPLANZ, a two-player Battleship-style game with airplanes, written in Game Boy assembly by NotImplementedLife: hide three planes on your grid, then take turns guessing where the opponent's are; hitting a cockpit downs the plane. Pass...

apps.name: All Things Devours
apps.author: Toby Ord (half sick of shadows); interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Sneak into a research lab to sabotage a time machine: a tight, unforgiving time-travel puzzle. Text adventure in English (Toby Ord (half sick of shadows), 2004). Type if-all-things-devours in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Apple Game
apps.author: João Gabriel de Campos Nassar
apps.description: You're an apple on the run from hungry snakes across 6 ever harder phases. Grab speed potions and shields and use the side portals. Arrows to move, Z to pause.

apps.name: Assemblio
apps.author: Philipp Lühmann
apps.description: A factory-building puzzle: lay conveyor belts to carry items into the central hub and reach the quota it asks for. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Beyond (Aldilà)
apps.author: Roberto Grassi, Paolo Lucchesi & Alessandro Peretti; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A mysterious death and a secret to reveal, among glass boxes, in the world beyond. Text-only version. Text adventure in Italian (Roberto Grassi, Paolo Lucchesi & Alessandro Peretti, 2005). Non-commercial licence. Type if-beyond in the...

apps.name: Big Space Iron
apps.author: kzerot
apps.description: A space shooter: pilot your ship against squadrons of enemy fighters, keeping an eye on your energy, speed and shields.

apps.name: Big2Small
apps.author: Matthew D. Steele (mdsteele); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Big2Small, a goofy puzzle game by mdsteele (2021): guide Elle the elephant, Gisele the goat and Melanie the mouse to their favourite food across 40 puzzles, using each animal's own abilities against rivers, pipes and mousetraps. Battery...

apps.name: Bigger Than You Think
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: A choice-based riff inspired by xkcd's huge "Click and Drag" comic: type one of the key words of each passage (the bold ones in other interpreters). Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 2012). Non-commercial licence. Type...

apps.name: Bit Bang
apps.author: StudioGuma; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Bit Bang, a binary numbers puzzle by StudioGuma (2024): build each target number in binary using increment, decrement and the two shifts, in as few moves as possible. Code GPL-3.0, assets CC BY-SA 4.0 (github.com/StudioGuma/bit_bang).

apps.name: Blue Chairs
apps.author: Chris Klimas; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A strange party, a strange drink, and a night that turns into a surreal dream about love. Text adventure in English (Chris Klimas, 2004). Non-commercial licence. Type if-blue-chairs in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Bombfighters
apps.author: Patbox
apps.description: A player-vs-player battle inspired by the multiplayer modes of 2D Bomberman games: drop bombs and blow up your opponents. Needs several gamepads.

apps.name: Book and Volume
apps.author: Nick Montfort; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A sysadmin in a sprawling tech city, paged all night long. A satire of the always-on workplace. Text adventure in English (Nick Montfort, 2005). Non-commercial licence. Type if-book-and-volume in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Bubblewrap
apps.author: Henrik Zenkert
apps.description: Pop the bubbles bouncing around the room by shooting upward as you move along the floor. Left and right to move, Up to shoot.

apps.name: Carazu
apps.author: Martin Holtkamp; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Carazu, a platformer for the original Game Boy by Martin Holtkamp, written in assembly. Run and jump through the levels; progress is saved on the cartridge battery. GPL-3.0 (github.com/mholtkamp/carazu).

apps.name: Changes
apps.author: David Given; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Elysia, a new Earth found by a starship on a thousand-year voyage, and you are not quite what you were. Text adventure in English (David Given, 2012). Type if-changes in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Cold Iron
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles); interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Your good axe has gone missing, and maybe the piskeys stole it. A short folk tale. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin (as Lyman Clive Charles), 2011). Non-commercial licence. Type if-cold-iron in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: comic-sans
apps.author: Eduardo Minholi, Nuno Abilio
apps.description: A fan-made survival challenge inspired by an iconic final battle: guide the SOUL through waves of bones and Flappy Bone walls. Arrows to move.

apps.name: Cosmic Hopper
apps.author: Bernardo Wilchen de Oliveira
apps.description: Help Zorp the alien hop across a highway of speeding spaceships and a stardust river to fill 4 landing pads, over 3 stages. Arrows to hop.

apps.name: CrossConnect
apps.author: Quinn Painter; WitchFont8 by Lavenfurr; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: CrossConnect, a Numberlink puzzle game by Quinn Painter (2022): connect every pair of matching nodes with lines so that the whole board is filled. Progress is saved on the cartridge. MIT license (github.com/QuinnPainter/CrossConnect).

apps.name: Customizable Pong
apps.author: UnusualEgg
apps.description: Classic Pong with customizable colors: pick the paddle, ball and palette colors, then save and load your settings. X returns to the menu.

apps.name: Dashy Dango
apps.author: samX500
apps.description: A wave fighting game: help the Dango survive waves of enemies by dashing into them to take them out.

apps.name: Dashy no Witch
apps.author: voxel; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Dashy no Witch, a Halloween 2019 Game Boy action game by voxel: Liquorice the cat was taken by a bat, so Dashy the witch flies through a sky full of bat-demons, dashing into them while avoiding spikes. 0BSD license...

apps.name: Delightful Wallpaper
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (as Edgar O. Weyrd); interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A ghoulishly funny manor-house murder mystery, in which you are not the detective. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin (as Edgar O. Weyrd), 2006). Non-commercial licence. Type if-delightful-wallpaper in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: disk-0 MADNESS
apps.author: Max Curzi
apps.description: Absorb enemies of your own color, dodge the rest and trigger bombs to recolor them. Survive as long as you can. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. X switches color.

apps.name: Dodgeball
apps.author: Sander in 't Veld
apps.description: Move around the arena and dodge the ball to rack up points, with a timer running on screen.

apps.name: Don't Smash Into Obstacles
apps.author: Mateusz Czarnecki
apps.description: A simple runner: jump over the obstacles coming your way and try not to smash into them to keep your score climbing.

apps.name: Doom 2 Reloaded
apps.author: Andy Stewart
apps.description: The story of Doom II retold in 32 new, linear maps.

apps.name: DOOM Shareware
apps.author: id Software
apps.description: The original 1993 shareware episode: Knee-Deep in the Dead, nine levels.

apps.name: Doom The Way id Did
apps.author: Various authors
apps.description: Three new episodes as if id Software had made them in 1993. Plays on Freedoom 1.

apps.name: Dragon Poker Draw
apps.author: LoneGrayWolf2000
apps.description: Six-card video poker inspired by Robert Asprin's Dragon Poker: bet, swap up to 4 cards and chase new hands like Full Dragon. Up to 4 jokers. X to confirm, Z for help.

apps.name: Dual Transform
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: One room, but not always the same one, and one object with more to it than it seems. Experiment. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 2010). Non-commercial licence. Type if-dual-transform in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Duck Maze
apps.author: Julia Marques Sanches
apps.description: You're a duck stuck in a maze: find your way through the corridors and get out. Arrows to move.

apps.name: Earth Invaders
apps.author: Yara F. Scramin
apps.description: Space Invaders turned around: Earth is the enemy. Destroy human ships, dodge bullets and unleash your ultimate. Arrows to move, X to shoot, Z for the ultimate.

apps.name: Edge Valley Bigfoot Society
apps.author: NegSec; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: A smarter-than-usual Bigfoot is caught by hunters: can he escape their facility? Six endings. Text adventure in English (NegSec, 2025). Type if-bigfoot-society in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Endless Runner
apps.author: Richard McCormack
apps.description: A minimalist endless runner: keep going and avoid the obstacles for as long as you can to push your score up.

apps.name: Escape Guldur
apps.author: Chris Heyes
apps.description: Escape from the dark fortress of Guldur. Can you get out alive? Made in Zig for the second WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Explore the Grotto
apps.author: Donatien Rabiller
apps.description: A top-down adventure: explore the rooms of the grotto, avoid the bats and find the way forward, with hearts for health.

apps.name: Fate
apps.author: Victor Gijsbers; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A queen in labour, trapped in a hostile castle, sees her son's fate in a crystal ball. Dark and short. Text adventure in English (Victor Gijsbers, 2007). Type if-fate in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Figaro
apps.author: Victor Gijsbers; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A short experiment: before playing, you decide what the world is like at the start of the game. Text adventure in English (Victor Gijsbers, 2010). Type if-figaro in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: First Flight
apps.author: bootra
apps.description: Play a young witch on her first flight: soar through the skies collecting rings and speed-ups as fast as you can. Arrows to fly, X to speed up, Z to slow down.

apps.name: Floppy Fish
apps.author: Chris Breece
apps.description: A small arcade game starring a fish, the author's very first WASM-4 creation, written in AssemblyScript.

apps.name: Fool's Paradise
apps.author: Dave Purdum
apps.description: A top-down shooter: fly your ship over the land, blast the enemy craft and survive from one day to the next, with hearts for health.

apps.name: Formula 1
apps.author: Davy Willems
apps.description: A Game & Watch-style LCD racer: move your car left and right to avoid the oncoming traffic and set a high score. Left/right to steer, X to start.

apps.name: Freedoom: Phase 2
apps.author: The Freedoom project
apps.description: 32 levels of free, Doom II-compatible action; also the base for the community megawads.

apps.name: FULL STEAM AHEAD TO THE RESCUE
apps.author: lluq
apps.description: Drive a steam locomotive 1600 m to an accident site in 120 seconds: shovel coal, vent pressure before the tank blows and brake to stop right at the end of the track.

apps.name: Future Avoid
apps.author: Joakim Hentula
apps.description: A reflex game: steer your dot around the screen and dodge the incoming triangles to keep your score going up.

apps.name: Fuzzy World Cup
apps.author: Damian Girardi, Sebastian Alvarez
apps.description: Penalty shoot-out against the computer: shoot left, center or right, then pick a side to save its kicks. Arrows to aim or dive, X to shoot.

apps.name: Game (Boy) of Life
apps.author: StudioGuma; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Game (Boy) of Life by StudioGuma (2024): John Conway's famous cellular automaton on the Game Boy. Draw a pattern of cells and watch it evolve. Code GPL-3.0, assets CC BY-SA 4.0 (github.com/StudioGuma/game_boy_of_life).

apps.name: Game Boy
apps.author: Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei, MiniGB APU by Alex Baines; NucleoOS
apps.description: Game Boy player (Peanut-GB, MIT): plays your own .gb games from /sdcard/home/roms with touch controls, gamepads, sound and battery saves. Homebrew: hh.gbdev.io.

apps.name: Game of Life
apps.author: Claudio Mattera
apps.description: Conway's Game of Life: watch the cells live, die and multiply generation after generation, with adjustable speed and a pause button.

apps.name: Game of Life: Zig Edition
apps.author: David Roman
apps.description: Conway's Game of Life with a brush to paint cells, adjustable speed and an invert mode. Up/Down brush size, Left/Right speed, X to pause, Z to switch mode.

apps.name: GB-Wordyl
apps.author: bbbbbr (based on the original by stacksmashing); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: GB-Wordyl, the five-letter word guessing game for the Game Boy by bbbbbr (English edition 0.85): six tries to find the hidden word, with a full dictionary of about 12,900 words, hard mode and game stats. GPL-3.0...

apps.name: Glitch Dungeon
apps.author: jakeonaut, Wormi
apps.description: A remake of jakeonaut's Glitch Dungeon: a platformer where you cast spells to get through the rooms. Arrows to move and jump, X cycles spells, Z respawns.

apps.name: Glowfish Chess
apps.author: Analog Hors
apps.description: A simple game of chess against a basic CPU or a second player. D-pad to move the cursor, Z to select and move pieces, X to undo.

apps.name: Glulxe
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (Glulxe, CheapGlk)
apps.description: Modern interactive fiction (Inform 7 / Glulx) in the Terminal. Copy a .gblorb or .ulx story to /sdcard/home, then type glulxe story.gblorb. Thousands of free games on ifdb.org.

apps.name: HAMMER JOE
apps.author: MFauzan26
apps.description: A single-screen arcade platformer: guide Joe and his hammer through stages full of enemies, with 3 lives and a timer.

apps.name: Hero of the Woods v3
apps.author: BigRobCoder
apps.description: Hero of the Woods: a top-down action game where an arrow on the screen edge points to your next objective. Arrows to move; tap the screen to change rotation mode.

apps.name: Hills in the Moonlight
apps.author: Samarth Hattangady
apps.description: A bike ride across rolling hills under the moon, made for the first WASM-4 game jam. Press X to start.

apps.name: Hoist Sail for the Heliopause and Home
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A short far-future story of discovery, told through a ship sailing the solar wind. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 2010). Non-commercial licence. Type if-heliopause in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Hoosegow
apps.author: Ben Collins-Sussman & Jack Welch; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Wild West jailbreak: get yourself and your partner out of the hoosegow before the hanging at dawn. Text adventure in English (Ben Collins-Sussman & Jack Welch, 2010). Non-commercial licence. Type if-hoosegow in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Image Carousel
apps.author: pfg
apps.description: A small graphics demo that shows a carousel of detailed dithered pictures, such as a mountain landscape, in just four colors.

apps.name: IOCCC 98 Flight Sim
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A port of the famous IOCCC 98 flight simulator: fly with the arrows, X throttles up and Z down, X+Down opens the map, X+Z returns to the menu.

apps.name: It's Corn!
apps.author: Sander in 't Veld
apps.description: A quick arcade game made in about a day for GBJam 10: move around, boost and chain combos to push your score up. Arrows to move, X for a boost.

apps.name: IWAS
apps.author: Mr.Rafael
apps.description: IWAS is a small music tool made for WASM-4: create a song within the console's limits and save it. Everything in the editor works with mouse or touch.

apps.name: Journey to Entorus
apps.author: Marcus Ramse
apps.description: A bullet hell with a short story: make your way to Entorus, and maybe back. Includes a Practice Mode and a harder Extra Story. Arrows to move, X and Z for the ship.

apps.name: Journey to the Steam Planet
apps.author: QuaternionWake
apps.description: Pilot a steam rocket: shoot asteroids and UFOs, dodge deadly steam puffs and collect fuel to reach the next level - but you can't fire while charging the engine.

apps.name: JP
apps.author: Graham Coulby (IonicLimb); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: JP, a casual jumping platform game for the Game Boy by Graham Coulby (IonicLimb, 2021): jump from platform to platform without falling and rack up points. MIT license (github.com/gcoulby/JP).

apps.name: JSON
apps.author: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors
apps.description: Validate, pretty-print, minify and query JSON files: cjson file.json, cjson -c file.json (compact), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json (pick a value), cjson -l file.jsonl (one value per line).

apps.name: Jump 'n' Shoot
apps.author: Matheus Foltran Consonni
apps.description: A fast action platformer: dodge obstacles, take out enemies and survive as long as you can; destroying enemies or their shots adds points. X to jump, Z to shoot.

apps.name: La Pietra della Luna
apps.author: Paolo Lucchesi; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A fantasy mystery: a young inquisitor investigates what hides in the forest nights of the Nigat valley. Text adventure in Italian (Paolo Lucchesi, 2003). Type if-pietra-della-luna in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Lad 2024
apps.author: YAMAMOTO Takashi
apps.description: A puzzle game: move your characters, push objects and switch between players to solve each stage; the first 8 are tutorials. Arrows to move, X to switch player.

apps.name: Lake Shooter
apps.author: Jimmy Cartrette
apps.description: A River Raid-style shooter: fly up the river, shoot the boats and helicopters and keep an eye on your fuel gauge.

apps.name: Last Train Home
apps.author: Reuben Dunnington
apps.description: A hex-based exploration puzzle with a train theme: select the tiles one by one to explore the map while keeping an eye on your resources.

apps.name: Lava Hop!
apps.author: Cannon Tuttle
apps.description: A vertical platformer: hop from platform to platform and keep climbing to stay clear of the lava below.

apps.name: Le Lande di Erisvalle
apps.author: Paolo Lucchesi; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: Explore the far lands of Erisvalle in search of seven relics of an ancient kingdom and seven runes of power. Text adventure in Italian (Paolo Lucchesi, 2022). Type if-lande-di-erisvalle in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Libbet and the Magic Floor
apps.author: Damian Yerrick (game); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Libbet and the Magic Floor by Damian Yerrick (zlib): a Game Boy puzzle game, roll the floor tiles to clear each room.

apps.name: Lime Volleyball
apps.author: Bruno Garcia
apps.description: Volleyball in the style of Slime Volleyball: move your blob, jump and bounce the ball over the net to score points.

apps.name: Lingword
apps.author: Jonathan Derque
apps.description: A Wordle-style word game: guess the hidden five-letter English word in six tries, with colored hints and an on-screen keyboard.

apps.name: Lists and Lists
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A genie teaches you a small version of the LISP programming language, with puzzles to solve in code. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1996). Type if-lists-and-lists in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Lumber Night
apps.author: Vitaly
apps.description: A night-time game set in a dark forest around a lonely cabin, made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Mandelbrot
apps.author: LukeGrahamLandry
apps.description: Explore the Mandelbrot fractal: Up/Down to zoom in and out, drag with mouse or touch to move around, X to toggle the Julia set.

apps.name: Markdown
apps.author: Martin Mitá (md4c)
apps.description: Render Markdown to HTML: md notes.md (HTML on stdout), md -f -o out.html notes.md (full document), md --gfm (GitHub-flavored tables/strikethrough/task lists).

apps.name: Match3
apps.author: Ben Smith
apps.description: A match-3 puzzle with emoji faces: swap neighbouring tiles to line up three or more of a kind and rack up points.

apps.name: Maze
apps.author: Ben Smith
apps.description: Find your way through a first-person 3D maze with textured walls and floor.

apps.name: Maze Wanderer
apps.author: Grant Handy
apps.description: A first-person raycasting demo: walk through a 3D maze and switch to the map editor to toggle walls. X to start, Z to switch modes.

apps.name: Mazethingie
apps.author: Davy Willems
apps.description: Generate mazes of the size you choose and guide the little red box from the bottom-right corner to the top-left exit. Arrows to move, X for a new maze.

apps.name: Melancholy: cart 0
apps.author: e-Alchmst
apps.description: A surreal little experience: explore the surroundings, fight your enemy, hunt for secrets and, above all, go outside. Part of the Melancholy project.

apps.name: Melancholy: cart 3
apps.author: e-Alchmst
apps.description: The surreal follow-up to Melancholy: cart 0: fight hordes of cultists, defeat the archmagus and discover the meaning of life. Part of the Melancholy project.

apps.name: Memento Mori
apps.author: The Memento Mori team
apps.description: The 1995 classic: 32 levels by 21 top mappers of the time, with its own soundtrack.

apps.name: Micro Quest
apps.author: André L. Alvares
apps.description: A tiny, minimalist quest in shades of green, made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: MIKU-15
apps.author: Mr.Rafael
apps.description: MIKU-15 by Mr.Rafael, a small game built around an anime-style illustration. Press X or Z to start.

apps.name: Mind Palace
apps.author: Matú Chovan
apps.description: A first-person 3D exploration game: wander through the rooms and find what's hidden, with a counter tracking your progress.

apps.name: Minesweeper
apps.author: Claudio Mattera
apps.description: Classic Minesweeper: uncover the squares without setting off a mine, using the numbers to work out where the mines are hidden.

apps.name: Mini Civ
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A Civilization-style strategy game: found cities, build units such as knights and triremes and grow your empire turn by turn.

apps.name: Minicraft
apps.author: TheFloatingPixel
apps.description: A semi-open-world sandbox: gather, craft and build on a random 50x50 map, then save at the campfire. X uses the item, Z opens the inventory; mouse works too.

apps.name: Mouse Demo
apps.author: David Sims
apps.description: A small test cart for the mouse: move the pointer and press the buttons to see each input detected on screen. Works with mouse or touch.

apps.name: NAIR DEMAKE
apps.author: MiguelGSS
apps.description: A demake of NAIR, a fighting game with a single attack: jump, dodge and land your NAIR. Z for the NAIR in the air, X to dodge, Up to jump, Down to crouch.

apps.name: Ninja vs Knights
apps.author: Mr.Rafael
apps.description: A platformer where a ninja takes on knights: slash knights, bombs and statues with your sword. Left/right to move, X to jump (hold for higher), Z to attack.

apps.name: Number Slide
apps.author: Giovana Ferreira Waterkemper, Jamily Go
apps.description: The classic 15-puzzle: slide the numbered tiles into the empty space until they are all in ascending order. Arrows to move the tiles, X to start.

apps.name: Nyan Cat
apps.author: Jake Ledoux
apps.description: The famous Nyan Cat flies across the screen with its rainbow trail in this small animated demo.

apps.name: One Slime Army
apps.author: Isaiah Billingsley
apps.description: An endless wave survival arcade game: a humble slime with sword and shield battles hordes of enemies. Arrows to move, hold Z to block, release to attack, X to dash.

apps.name: Palette Previewer
apps.author: David Sims
apps.description: A handy tool to preview four-color palettes on WASM-4: browse the palettes and see how each one looks on a sample image, with its name and author.

apps.name: panelpon4
apps.author: CanyonTurtle
apps.description: A Panel de Pon-style block matching game: swap panels to line up matching colors as the stack keeps rising. Press X to start.

apps.name: Particle Editor v1.0
apps.author: Dominik Koperkiewicz
apps.description: An editor for the author's WASM-4 particle system: design effects with the mouse, zoom and pan the view, then export the settings. Hold Z and move to set the emitter area.

apps.name: Pega-Pega: the game
apps.author: Ana Paula Crippa, Maria Eduarda Polican
apps.description: A two-player chase-and-shoot duel: follow your opponent around and fire as soon as you have them in your sights. Two gamepads needed. Arrows to move, X to shoot.

apps.name: Pelmanism
apps.author: TeamKNOx (Osamu Ohashi); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Pelmanism, the classic memory card game (Concentration) for the Game Boy by TeamKNOx (2001): turn over two cards at a time and find all the pairs, plus two more modes, Marky and Flasher, on the game select screen. MIT license...

apps.name: PHANTOM SHIFT
apps.author: Sergey Poznyak
apps.description: Switch your light on and off to phase between two worlds and find your way through 3 levels - just don't phase into a wall! A 1-bit jam entry.

apps.name: Piano
apps.author: pfg
apps.description: A playable chiptune piano: choose the key, the waveform (pulse, triangle or noise), the duty cycle and the fade, then play the notes.

apps.name: PID Controller
apps.author: rezajamesahmed
apps.description: A PID controller simulator: tune the KP, KI and KD gains and watch the dial settle on the set point. X to run, Z to reset, arrows to tune.

apps.name: PING
apps.author: Cannon Tuttle
apps.description: A twist on Pong: move, lunge and catch the ball; choose colors, difficulty and match length. Up to 4 players with several gamepads. Arrows to move, X/Z to lunge or catch.

apps.name: Pixel vs Zombies
apps.author: Vitor Lorençone
apps.description: A Plants vs. Zombies-inspired game: place plants to hold back the zombies across 3 levels, with 5 plants and 3 zombie types. Mouse or touch to select and plant.

apps.name: Plasma Cube
apps.author: unnick
apps.description: A graphics demo: a spinning 3D cube covered in a colorful, animated plasma texture.

apps.name: Platformer Test
apps.author: Bruno Garcia
apps.description: A simple platformer test: run and jump across the blocks with a little bunny-like hero. A tech demo from WASM-4's early days.

apps.name: Plutonia 2
apps.author: The PL2 team
apps.description: Fan-made sequel to Final Doom: Plutonia. 32 very hard maps.

apps.name: Pl¢tfarmer
apps.author: pfg
apps.description: Pl¢tfarmer is a side-view game set on a rolling landscape of hills and valleys, created for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Pogoman GO!
apps.author: Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: No job, no family: time to catch every Pogoman in town. A satire of mobile gaming. Text adventure in English (Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman, 2016). Non-commercial licence. Type if-pogoman-go in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Pong
apps.author: Fabrizio Vitale
apps.description: The classic Pong: move your paddle up and down, return the ball and score when your opponent misses.

apps.name: PostBot
apps.author: Tobias Rojahn; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: PostBot, a programming puzzle game for the Game Boy by Tobias Rojahn (2018): write a short program of moves and turns for a little robot, then run it to deliver every transmission in the level. MIT license (github.com/MasterIV/PostBot).

apps.name: Presents to the Metal
apps.author: errorStream
apps.description: A festive platformer: jump across stacks of crates and grab the presents scattered around each level.

apps.name: Projectron
apps.author: James McMurray
apps.description: A Tron-style light-cycle duel: race around the arena leaving a trail behind you and make your rival crash first.

apps.name: Punch'Em Up
apps.author: Louis Pearson
apps.description: A tiny, unfinished beat 'em up made for the WASM-4 jam: take on the enemies with your fists and, above all, have fun punching the pots!

apps.name: Puyo
apps.author: Shigeki Karita
apps.description: A Puyo Puyo-style falling puzzle: stack the falling blobs and link four of the same color to pop them and trigger chains.

apps.name: Racer
apps.author: Claudio Mattera
apps.description: A pseudo-3D racing game: speed down a winding desert road past the cacti, with a speedometer and a track map on screen.

apps.name: Raw Assembly Test
apps.author: Bruno Garcia
apps.description: A tiny tech demo written directly in WebAssembly text format, showing a message and a smiley. Mostly of interest to developers.

apps.name: Rex Run
apps.author: el_seyf; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Rex Run by el_seyf (2019): a mostly faithful Game Boy port of the dinosaur runner game from Chrome. Jump over the cacti and avoid the birds for as long as you can. GPL-3.0 (github.com/elseyf/rex-run-gb).

apps.name: Rex Runner GB
apps.author: The Void (etdv-thevoid); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Rex Runner GB by The Void (2024): a clone of Chrome's popular dinosaur game for the Game Boy, with a scoreboard saved on the cartridge. Jump the cacti and dodge the birds. MIT license (github.com/etdv-thevoid/rex-runner-gb).

apps.name: Risorgimento Represso
apps.author: Michael J. Coyne; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A bored student falls through a portal into a wizard's library and becomes his accidental apprentice. Comedy. Text adventure in English (Michael J. Coyne, 2003). Non-commercial licence. Type if-risorgimento-represso in the Terminal or...

apps.name: Rolly Dango
apps.author: William Guimont-Martin
apps.description: A game starring a round, jelly-like dango, made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Rover's Day Out
apps.author: Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: Winner of IFComp 2009: a morning routine, a dog, and a spaceship on a 1200-degree exoplanet. Text adventure in English (Jack Welch & Ben Collins-Sussman, 2009). Non-commercial licence. Type if-rovers-day-out in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Rubido
apps.author: Davy Willems
apps.description: Peg solitaire with four difficulties: jump pegs over each other to remove them until only one remains. Arrows and X to play, or mouse and touch.

apps.name: Salvate lo Stregatto!
apps.author: Marco Vallarino; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: The Cheshire Cat, mascot of a games club, is missing: find it before it becomes a fur coat. Short comedy. Text adventure in Italian (Marco Vallarino, 2013). Type if-stregatto in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Samurai Revenge
apps.author: Krylan, Dominik Koperkiewicz
apps.description: An endless action game driven by revenge: run, jump and slide, deflect bullets with your sword and dash past walls for a high score. Sword, dash and slow motion use the mouse.

apps.name: Save the Cheshire Cat!
apps.author: Marco Vallarino; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: English version of Salvate lo Stregatto!: find the missing cat before it is turned into a fur coat. Text adventure in English (Marco Vallarino, 2014). Type if-cheshire-cat in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Scythe
apps.author: Erik Alm
apps.description: 32 short, fast maps that ramp up to a brutal third episode. Plays on Freedoom 2.

apps.name: Seal Adventure
apps.author: katspaugh
apps.description: Guide a seal through the northern seas and avoid the deadly icebergs, on a map generated procedurally with cellular automata.

apps.name: Seed Creator Showcase
apps.author: huntrss@posteo.me
apps.description: A developer demo showing how to build a random seed: click or tap the rectangles to make a pattern, then press accept.

apps.name: Shade
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A one-room game set in your apartment, the night before a trip to the desert. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 2000). Non-commercial licence. Type if-shade in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Shieldshooter
apps.author: Marcus Ramse
apps.description: A simple platform shooter: shoot the other players and raise your shield to block their shots. There is no win condition. X to shoot, Z to shield.

apps.name: Shock Lobster
apps.author: Dave VanEe (tbsp); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Shock Lobster by Dave VanEe (tbsp), a Game Boy Competition 2021 entry: a lowly lobster with magical powers swims forward, jetting over obstacles and zapping enemies; collect pearls to unlock skills, upgrades and items and push your high...

apps.name: SIGIL (DOS edition)
apps.author: John Romero, adapted by the_kovic
apps.description: John Romero's unofficial fifth episode, reworked to vanilla limits. Replaces episode 3.

apps.name: Simple Rocket
apps.author: Venkatesh.H
apps.description: Steer a small rocket left and right across the screen in this minimal game made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Skip Ahead
apps.author: Dennis Ranke
apps.description: Bounce your ball from tile to tile along a 3D track and skip ahead as far as you can without falling off.

apps.name: Smash Sugar Parallelepipeds
apps.author: Lázaro Albuquerque
apps.description: A Breakout-style game: bounce the ball with your paddle and smash all the bricks, keeping track of your lives and score.

apps.name: Snake
apps.author: Tomas Tulka
apps.description: The classic Snake: eat the fruit to grow longer and don't bite your own tail or hit the walls.

apps.name: Snakery
apps.author: hahahahaman
apps.description: A grid-based puzzle game: collect all the $ symbols to solve each level.

apps.name: So Far
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A current of air in a cramped theatre leads you into strange, dreamlike worlds. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1996). Type if-so-far in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Sokoban
apps.author: Lars Hamre
apps.description: The classic Sokoban warehouse puzzle: push the boxes onto their target spots without getting them stuck in a corner.

apps.name: Sound Demo
apps.author: Bruno Garcia
apps.description: An interactive demo of the WASM-4 sound system: tweak frequency, envelope, volume, channel and mode, then play the tone. Arrows to adjust, X to play.

apps.name: Sound Test
apps.author: Mr.Rafael
apps.description: A mouse-driven sound lab for WASM-4 with draggable controls and a simple music composer, handy for finding sound effects. X or Z changes the palette.

apps.name: Space Delivery
apps.author: kirinokirino
apps.description: Travel through space between the planets in this delivery-themed game made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Space Kommand
apps.author: korhadris
apps.description: Command a starship in space combat: manage its heading and speed, check its systems and fire at enemy ships.

apps.name: Spider and Web
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A captured spy tells an interrogator how he broke in, and nothing is quite as it seems. A classic. Text adventure in English (Andrew Plotkin, 1998). Type if-spider-and-web in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: SpiritWrak
apps.author: Daniel S. Yu; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Set in the world of Zork: recover the shattered Rod of the Ancients, up to the Implementors themselves. Text adventure in English (Daniel S. Yu, 1996). Type if-spiritwrak in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Spunky
apps.author: Richard McCormack
apps.description: A platformer: jump across the blocks, avoid the spikes and grab the collectibles to raise your score.

apps.name: Squishy the Turtle
apps.author: cppchriscpp (potatolain); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Squishy the Turtle, a puzzle game made in 48 hours for Ludum Dare 34: collect Squishy's lost eggs while avoiding spiders and crabs, growing big to cross piranha rivers and shrinking small to slip through tiny passages. MIT license...

apps.name: Starfighter Arena
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A multiplayer-only space battle: fly a ship designed in Starfighter Ship Creator and manage your energy as you move and shoot. Arrows to move, buttons for radar and fire.

apps.name: Starfighter Ship Creator
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: Design your own starship for Starfighter Arena: place vertices on a symmetrical grid with the mouse, then use the generated code to fly it in battle.

apps.name: StarShard Scavengers
apps.author: HitchH1k3r
apps.description: Fly a spaceship, shoot asteroids and collect StarShards, then bring them to your station to score. Single-player is for practice. Warning: flashing colors.

apps.name: Strikeforce
apps.author: iszn_11
apps.description: A top-down arena shooter: move through the rooms, avoid the fire of the turrets around you and keep your HP up.

apps.name: Synth
apps.author: NucleoOS + AMY (Brian Whitman, Dan Ellis)
apps.description: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

apps.name: T Flight Simulator 1.0
apps.author: Tau
apps.description: A physics-based flight simulator: reach the runway, then learn to land and shake off missiles by flying low. Arrows for yaw and throttle; pitch and roll use a second gamepad.

apps.name: Tail Gunner
apps.author: Dial0
apps.description: Take on enemy planes and dodge their shots among the clouds in this aerial shooter made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Tank Battle
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A multiplayer-only tank battle: destroy the enemy tanks and try your luck with mystery packages - not all help. Arrows to move, buttons to shoot and stop.

apps.name: Tank Wars
apps.author: Shimon Ulewicz
apps.description: A 3D tank battle: hit the other tanks with your shells to score, and the first to 10 points wins. Up to 4 players with several gamepads.

apps.name: Tankle
apps.author: Milky Natas
apps.description: A top-down tank battle: take on the enemy tanks on the field, with stats for speed, shot trajectory and cooldown shown next to your level.

apps.name: Tankle Adventure
apps.author: Milky Natas
apps.description: A top-down tank adventure through forests and mountains: blast the enemy tanks and turrets in your way. Z to fire, X to dash if you have Nitro.

apps.name: The Art of Fugue
apps.author: Victor Gijsbers, Jimmy Maher, Dorte Lassen & Johan; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: Pure logic puzzles: four actors perform your commands, each with a growing delay, like the voices of a fugue. Text adventure in English (Victor Gijsbers, Jimmy Maher, Dorte Lassen & Johan, 2010). Type if-art-of-fugue in the Terminal or...

apps.name: The Life (and Deaths) of Doctor M
apps.author: Michael D. Hilborn; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
apps.description: You land in an endless, windy landscape and piece together the life of a mad scientist. Text adventure in English (Michael D. Hilborn, 2011). Non-commercial licence. Type if-doctor-m in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: The Romans Are Coming
apps.author: Sander in 't Veld
apps.description: Place banners to score and gather grain, wood, stone and wine; fail the imperial decrees and Roman troops arrive. Survive as long as you can. Mouse or touch to play.

apps.name: The Royal Game of Ur
apps.author: Gelatin Studios
apps.description: The Royal Game of Ur, one of the oldest known board games, for two players on one device. Up/Down to pick a piece, X to roll and move.

apps.name: Tic Tac Toe
apps.author: Christopher Kleine
apps.description: Classic tic-tac-toe on a 3x3 grid: take turns placing X and O and line up three in a row to win.

apps.name: Tiny Pong
apps.author: Ztry8
apps.description: A tiny Pong written in C in just 1001 bytes and 50 lines of code: move your paddle and return the ball.

apps.name: TO THE CORE
apps.author: Garrett Hale
apps.description: A semi-idle game: guide Pant Ant on his journey home to the center of the earth, with Wormie explaining the rules. Z opens the tool kit, X picks and uses a tool.

apps.name: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe
apps.author: Tangram Games (sound by potato-tan); Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
apps.description: Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe, the remastered edition of Tangram Games' arcade platformer: bounce on enemies to climb as high as you can before time runs out. Runs in original Game Boy mode on the built-in emulator. Code MIT, assets CC BY 4.0...
apps.license: MIT (code), CC BY 4.0 (graphics, text, sound and music) (game); MIT (emulator)

apps.name: Totally not sumo
apps.author: André L. Alvares
apps.description: Definitely not a sumo game: push your opponents out while wrestling with a tricky dual control scheme. Local multiplayer with several gamepads.

apps.name: Touhou Spirits
apps.author: Mr.Rafael
apps.description: A Touhou fangame built around cards: choose a character with stats like attack, defense and magic and save as many spirits as you can.

apps.name: Train!
apps.author: Davidian1024
apps.description: Snake on rails: hook each new train car onto the end of your train without crashing into the cars or yourself. Watch the demo to see how it's done.

apps.name: Trials of the dark sea
apps.author: ericvilcu
apps.description: A short game made for the 2022 WASM-4 jam: steer a small red craft through a dark sea dotted with glowing lights.

apps.name: Tristam Island
apps.author: Hugo Labrande; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Your plane crashes at sea and you drift to a deserted island: why did its people leave? An Infocom-style adventure. Text adventure in English (Hugo Labrande, 2020). Type if-tristam-island in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: UEM Mini Game
apps.author: Thiago Calvi
apps.description: Dodge obstacles rushing at you down a road with a 3D depth effect: move and jump to survive as your score rises. Arrows to move, Up to jump, Z to pause.

apps.name: Untangle
apps.author: Mota Link
apps.description: A relaxing de-cluttering puzzle: drag the points around until none of the lines connecting them cross. Tap or click a point to select it, then drag it.

apps.name: Villa Morgana
apps.author: Paolo Lucchesi; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: Locked in an old mansion, looking for a friend: an introduction to text adventures with a step-by-step guide. Text adventure in Italian (Paolo Lucchesi, 2006). Type if-villa-morgana in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: WASM Invaders
apps.author: Lorenzo Henrique Zanetti, Matheus Cener
apps.description: A Space Invaders-inspired arcade shooter: defend the galaxy from endless waves of aliens that get faster and more numerous. Left/right to move, X to shoot.

apps.name: Wasm Wars
apps.author: Daniel Kiyoshi
apps.description: A turn-based tactics game in the style of Advance Wars: move your units across a map of roads, forests and cities.

apps.name: WASM-4 City
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A port of MicroCity for Arduboy: build and manage your own city in a SimCity-style simulation. Arrows to move around, buttons to act. No sound.

apps.name: WASM-4 RPG
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A simple RPG with levels, inventory, quests and exploration across a huge procedurally generated map. No sound yet.

apps.name: Wasm4 Gameboy VGM Player
apps.author: Sine System
apps.description: A proof-of-concept music player that emulates the Game Boy sound chip on WASM-4 and plays a chiptune from a VGM file.

apps.name: wasm4nia
apps.author: Marcus Ramse
apps.description: A rhythm game: hit the notes in time with the music, with 4-Key and Index chart modes and an audio offset setting. X to confirm, Z to go back.

apps.name: WASMstein 3D
apps.author: Jeremy Zeiber
apps.description: A port of Wolfenduino 3D FX: a Wolfenstein-style first-person shooter whose maps are randomly generated on every playthrough.

apps.name: Waternet
apps.author: Davy Willems
apps.description: A pipe puzzle: connect every pipe so water flows from the source by rotating pipes, sliding rows and columns, or both in Roslid mode. X to act, Z to go back.

apps.name: Watris
apps.author: Bruno Garcia
apps.description: A Tetris-style falling block game: rotate and drop the pieces to complete lines, with level, score and best score on screen.

apps.name: Win 4 Fighter (W4F)
apps.author: Kris Dabrowski
apps.description: A minimalist fighting game based on the core of Virtua Fighter, meant for two players: punch, guard, crouch and throw. Press punch and guard together to throw.

apps.name: Wired
apps.author: Louis Pearson
apps.description: Collect coins by solving puzzles with wires and circuits. Left/right to move, Up/Down to interact above or below, Z to grab wires and flip switches, X to jump.

apps.name: WLOKU
apps.author: 12Boti
apps.description: A two-player game on a cave-like map, with P1 and P2 starting on opposite sides. Made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: Wormhole
apps.author: David Sims
apps.description: Wormhole, a game written in C on WASM-4 for GBJam 9 in 2021, with a look inspired by the Game Boy.

apps.name: Wumpus Hunt
apps.author: Troy Wiegand
apps.description: A take on the classic Hunt the Wumpus: move between rooms, look around for clues and shoot to take down the Wumpus.

apps.name: You Will Return
apps.author: Sander in 't Veld
apps.description: You Will Return, a space-themed game set above a dark planet, made for the first WASM-4 game jam.

apps.name: ZenFactor Spa
apps.author: Tristano Ajmone; interpreter: Frotz 2.55
apps.description: A short tutorial adventure: visit a company in Turin to find out what text adventures are about. Text adventure in Italian (Tristano Ajmone, 2010). Type if-zenfactor-spa in the Terminal or tap the icon.

apps.name: Zigtris
apps.author: Toby Jaffey
apps.description: Yet another Tetris: move and spin the falling blocks to clear lines. X to start, arrows to move, Up to spin.

apps.name: Zip
apps.author: Rich Geldreich and contributors (miniz)
apps.description: Create, list and extract .zip archives: zip archive.zip file1 file2 (create), zip -l archive.zip (list), zip -x archive.zip [dir] (extract).

apps.name: Zone 300
apps.author: Paul Corfiatis
apps.description: 32 compact maps of at most 300 lines each, with an original soundtrack.

apps.name: Zoop Zoop Bee Adventures 7
apps.author: Garrett Hale
apps.description: Defend your meadows from Dick Dastardly Duck as a bee, with team and solo high scores. Drop-in play for up to 4 bees with several gamepads. X to start, arrows to move.

apps.name: ZxZ
apps.author: cisaw Dercz
apps.description: An action platformer set in a purple maze of pipes and platforms crawling with creatures, with an energy bar at the bottom. A WASM-4 game jam entry.
